# Nisaab360

> Nisaab360 is a school management and learning platform for schools, colleges, and academies in Pakistan. It brings administration, academics, attendance, fees, and parent communication into one connected system.

This website is Nisaab360's public, single-page product introduction and institution access request website. Dashboard and mobile previews are illustrations, not live institution data or verified customer statistics.

## Platform and features

- [Home](/): Introduction to Nisaab360 and its benefits for educational institutions.
- [Platform overview](/#platform): Connected campus, student, staff, and academic records.
- [Features](/#features): Admissions, student and staff attendance, fee records and vouchers, classes, timetables, exams, results, diaries, assignments, course materials, online tests, and announcements.
- [Role-specific portals](/#portals): Administration tools; teacher attendance and classroom work; student courses, submissions, and results; parent attendance, homework, fees, and updates.

## Plans and getting started

- [Plans and institution access request](/#request): Select Basic, Standard, Premium, or Enterprise and review the displayed pricing. Submit institution and contact details for the team to review and follow up.

The request form asks for institution name, contact name, email, phone, city, address, and a selected plan. Government registration ID, student range, and a message can be supplied as additional details. Submitting a request does not immediately create an institution account.

Pricing and terms should be checked in the current request section. This marketing website does not provide signed-in institution, teacher, student, or parent portals.
